def factor_vol_amplified_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    momentum = close / close.shift(20) - 1.0
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
    factor = momentum * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_vol_amplified_momentum"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_amplified_momentum"]
description: Price-volume coherence: momentum over the last 20 days is weighted by the continuous volume ratio from classify_volume_regime. This amplifies the signal when volume expansion confirms the price movement, ensuring that only volume-backed trends are emphasized. The raw factor captures the interaction between price direction and volume conviction.
